info.description: T01–T10 source; AWS validation gate required. All IDs are server-generated. Epoch timestamps in UTC seconds. Password reset/change and email verification use Cognito directly; passwords never enter this API.

CognitoAccessToken.description: Cognito access token from the same configured user pool and app client, with aws.cognito.signin.user.admin scope. API Gateway verifies signature, issuer, audience and scopes; backend checks access token type, enabled account, ownership and current admin membership.

configuration.description: Omit or submit the exact configuration returned by the catalog.

key.description: No empty, dot, parent or .cloudhub segments.

in_use.description: Restore, export or delete lock is held.

retirement_protected.description: Final backup deletion and retention expiry are blocked until source cleanup is confirmed.

SshKey.description: Sensitive: owner-only, no-store, never log or persist in browser storage. Download to local OpenSSH client.

text.description: UTF-8 bytes <=256. Newline/tab allowed; other control characters rejected.

key.description: No empty, dot, parent or .cloudhub segments.

role.description: Server-owned profile role; never accepted from signup.

enabled.description: Effective CloudHub access; local disable fails closed.

actual_milliusd.description: Gross tagged UnblendedCost; missing data is null, never assumed zero.
